en.bdb: Without Guru, the goings and comings continue

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇਹ ਤੇ ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਅਚੇਤ ਚੰਗੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: manmukh maanas dheh te pasoo paret achet cha(n)gere|

en.bdb: Animals and ghosts said to be without wisdom are better than manmukh the mind-orientated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਸੁਚੇਤ ਅਚੇਤ ਹੋਇ ਮਾਣਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਦੇ ਵਲਿ ਹੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: hoi suchet achet hoi maanas maanas dhe val here|

en.bdb: Even being wise the man becomes fool and goes on looking towards men (to meet his selfish ends).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਸੂ ਨ ਮੰਗੈ ਪਸੂ ਤੇ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਘੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: pasoo na ma(n)gai pasoo te pa(n)kheroo pa(n)kheroo ghere|

en.bdb: An animal from animals and a bird from birds never ask for anything.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਲਖ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਤਮ ਮਾਣਸ ਜੂਨਿ ਭਲੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: chauraaseeh lakh joon vich utam maanas joon bhalere|

en.bdb: Among eighty-four lakh species of life, the human life is the best one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤਮ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਲਖ ਫੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: autam man bach karam kar janam maran bhavajal lakh fere|

en.bdb: Having even the best mind, speech and actions, man goes on transmigtraing in the ocean of life and death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜਾ ਪਰਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਭਲੇ ਭਲੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: raajaa parajaa hoi kai sukh vich dhukh hoi bhale bhalere|

en.bdb: Whether it is a king or the people, even the good persons suffer the fear (of going away) from pleasure.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਤਾ ਰਾਜ ਬਹਾਲੀਐ ਚਕੀ ਚਟਣ ਜਾਇ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: kutaa raaj bahaaleeaai chakee chaTan jai anhere|

en.bdb: Dog, even if enthroned, according to its basic nature goes on to lick the flourmill at the fall of darkness.
Without the perfect Guru one has to stay in the abode of womb i.e. the transmigration never ends.
